note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. Needs delegated Graph permissions on the PnP app (Group.ReadWrite.All, ChannelMember.ReadWrite.All) and Teams policies that allow private and shared channels. Run -Provision the day before the browser screens.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
if (Get-PnPTeamsTeam -Filter "displayName eq 'Contoso Purchasing Team'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'Team already exists: plan will find it by name' }

screens.name: provision
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: One device-code sign-in (admin) off camera. Team and channel sites can take minutes; record what really happens.

screens.name: files
screens.account: alex.demo (and riley.demo in a second profile)
steps: Open Teams > Contoso Purchasing Team > channel 'Supplier Reviews' > Files tab > Open in SharePoint
Show the team site's Documents library: folders General and Supplier Reviews, and the Contoso Operations hub bar if shown
Back in Teams open channel 'Contract Negotiation' > Files > Open in SharePoint: a different site with its own address and Documents library
Show both address bars (host masked, site names visible); check 'Facilities Handover' shows the same pattern
Second profile as Riley Demo (member, not in the private channel): 'Contract Negotiation' is not in the channel list
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar

screens.name: tab
steps: Open Contoso Purchasing Team > General channel
Show the tab row: Posts, Files, How to buy
Open 'How to buy': the buying guide page of Contoso Purchasing renders inside Teams
Open the 'Supplier Reviews' channel and its 'Supplier Documents' tab (the episode 4 library)
If a tab shows a sign-in or 'refused to connect' message, record that as is
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar

screens.name: check
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
commands: # the owner of Contract Negotiation removes Alex from the channel
screens.note: Done with the signed-in labadmin PnP connection left by the script (labadmin is a team owner); if that connection is not usable, remove Alex in Teams as Jordan Demo (Manage channel > Members) and re-run -Check. Expect TL004 and '1 error(s)'.

teardown: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
Get-PnPTenantDeletedSite | Where-Object Url -like '*contoso-purchasing-team*' | ForEach-Object { Remove-PnPTenantDeletedSite -Identity $_.Url -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
needs: app:MG Lab PnP (+ delegated Graph Group.ReadWrite.All, ChannelMember.ReadWrite.All)
